decision.reason: [ev-1252a2a51c0c] says only that extra white space between namespaces is now allowed in the networking.istio.io/exportTo annotation. It does not say which resource kinds carry this annotation, so the evidence does not support the proposed list of VirtualService, DestinationRule, ServiceEntry and Gateway. The proposed condition is also too broad. It flags every environment that sets the annotation, but only environments whose annotation value has white space between namespaces are affected by the relaxed parsing. To write a correct condition, I need evidence naming the resource kinds that carry the annotation and saying how white-space values were handled before this release (for example, rejected or ignored).
